```plato

    //==
    // # Derived triangle connectivity
    //
    // Recovering `TriangleMeshTopology` from a bare `TriangleMesh3D`. This is the
    // step a mutable remesher does once and then maintains incrementally; here it
    // is done once per pass and thrown away, which is what removes the incremental
    // bookkeeping from every algorithm below.
    //
    // An undirected edge is a twin pair of corners named by the lower of the two
    // (a boundary corner names its own edge), and its number is the RANK of that
    // naming corner among all naming corners — the same canonical-corner rule
    // `meshes-polygon.library.plato` uses for `PolygonMesh3D`.
    //
    // Cost: quadratic in the corner count, and it dominates every pass built on it.

    // The twin of every corner, in corner order.
    CornerTwinTable(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<CornerIndex>
        => self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => self.TwinCorner(CornerIndex(c)));
```
